title: Bitcoin’s next crash may come from holders, not leverage, as $10.7 billion gets liquidated
summary: Bitcoin futures open interest fell 12% last week to $29.3 billion, its lowest level since early March, according to Glassnode's Nov. 23 Market Pulse. Over the same week to Nov. 22, the ratio of short-term-holder supply to long-term-holder supply rose from 15% to 15.5%, its highest since late February.
